summary: The explicit-null no-payload guard is corrected and covered by a focused 502 test.

evidence: src/provider/cerebras.ts now treats content: null like omitted content when no tool call or refusal exists, causing normalization to fail and the handler to return cerebras_upstream_invalid_response (502).
tests/cerebras-reasoning-strip.test.ts adds a focused reasoning-only content:null test asserting HTTP 502 and the expected error code.
